rule: Every finite element must satisfy abs(actual-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference). Shape and dtype interpretation must match. Nonfinite values fail.
modes: decode-to-decode and replay-to-replay only; chunked is separately labeled. Cross-mode differences never set or relax these bounds.
basis: Provisional engineering limits fixed before original-weight comparisons. BF16 families allow two relative BF16 spacings (2^-6); float32 families allow small accumulation-order differences. Same-mode repeatability has not been measured by the retained oracle, and these limits do not claim otherwise. A failure requires a code fix or a reported divergence, never a larger limit.
selection: Compare router expert sets exactly except a row whose oracle-recorded selection margin is exactly zero. Report every skipped exact tie and every near tie; a nonzero margin never grants an exception. Index and candidate selections follow the same recorded-exact-tie rule. Hashes are diagnostic, not a substitute for numerical comparisons.
coverage: Missing tensors, positions, prompts, modes, or reports are untested and keep G1 incomplete; they cannot count as passing.
